name: cryptoauthlib
description: Microchip CryptoAuthentication Library (ATECC608B et al.), vendored subset of MicrochipTech/cryptoauthlib v3.7.9 lib/ for the Noethrion ESP32 Arduino firmware. Upstream library.json has no build section, so PlatformIO cannot build it from git directly; this manifest fixes srcDir/includeDir and trims non-ESP32 HALs, PKCS#11, TLS backends and JWT. atca_config.h is hand-written (CMake would normally generate it).
